_comment: Manual curation layer for the client repository. Anything set here wins over the inferred classification and is reported at High confidence — this is where hand-researched funding data goes (Tracxn/Crunchbase/press), since Kylas does not carry it. Key a company by its Kylas company id under by_id (stable, preferred) or by company name under by_name (case-insensitive, use when you only have the name). Recognised keys per entry: venture_class, macro_industry, round_type, round_size, funding_date, investors, employee_count, notes. Only set what you actually know; unset keys fall back to inference. The two entries below are illustrative — delete them once you add real ones.

_example_5381741.notes: Round confirmed from the Nov-2025 press release; headcount from LinkedIn.
